highlights: Billing Pro Android style animated splash loading screen with UNIQON logo.
ESC key exit confirmation dialog with automatic closing safety backup.
Swiggy & Zomato toggle in Settings to keep billing screen clean and spacious.
Online Order ID tracking with non-cash accounting for delivery partners.
Mouse Right-Click item quantity decrement (-1) and instant cart management.
Day-End Closing (Z-Report) date picker and historical sales calendar navigation.
Motherboard-locked persistent offline hardware licensing (survives OS formats).
Calibrated 80mm thermal receipt printing for TVS RP 3230, eliminating cutoff and balancing margins with Dynamic UPI QR code.
Flawless Tamil script thermal printing with HarfBuzz ligature rendering (டி, ரை, முழு, ணி).
Instant Payment Mode Switcher in Bills (F9) to re-tag table orders to UPI or Card without reprinting.
Interactive Bill-by-Bill Breakdown tab in Day-End Z-Report with Cash/UPI/Card filtering.
Full itemized dish audit breakdown in Day-End Excel (CSV) export.
Automatic Windows Defender exclusion, firewall whitelisting, and third-party antivirus protection guide.
